gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically or cytologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme, anaplastic astrocytoma, or gliosarcoma, and is deemed a potential candidate for resection of the recurrent tumor.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Recurrent MG: To determine the safety and tolerability of M032 at the doses examined when given in combinations with pembrolizumab in patients with recurrent MG. (interventions: Drug: M032; Drug: Pembrolizumab)

This Phase I (Cohort I and Cohort II) and Phase II trial is designed to confirm the safety and tolerability of Pembrolizumab when given in conjunction with M032, an Oncolytic Herpes Simplex Virus (oHSV) that expresses IL-12

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Patients With Recurrent/Progressive and Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Multiforme, Grade 3 or Grade 4 Astrocytoma, or Gliosarcoma

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab: Starting at week four, patients will undergo treatment on the same day, and every three weeks thereafter, with intravenous infusion of 200mg of Pembrolizumab .
M032 (NSC 733972), a Genetically Engineered HSV-1 Expressing IL-12

agents.drug_class_hint: oncolytic herpes simplex virus type 1 expressing IL-12 (M032, NSC 733972), intratumoral

role_evidence.quote: They will then undergo treatment with standard fractionated radiation, and temozolomide as determined by treating physician.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent (standard backbone, newly diagnosed cohorts)

coder_notes: M032 oncolytic virus listed as excluded type; pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (per manual worked example pembrolizumab + investigational vaccine). Temozolomide not a registered intervention; given with RT in newly diagnosed cohorts at physician discretion. MGMT unmethylated mentioned only as an alternative prior-therapy pathway for recurrent cohort (not an entry requirement), so not listed as a biomarker. A Rickham catheter is placed for CSF collection, but no CSF drug-level or pharmacodynamic analysis is stated, so tumour PK and target engagement coded no. formulation_flag new_route for M032 reflects intratumoral delivery.
